description: This Java source file defines the ScreenCache class, which extends AbstractCache and manages caching of GenericWidgetOutput objects associated with screen names and widget context cache keys within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ScreenCache
classes.description: A cache class for storing and retrieving GenericWidgetOutput objects associated with screens and widget contexts within the OFBiz widget framework.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a GenericWidgetOutput associated with the specified screen name and widget context cache key.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores a GenericWidgetOutput in the cache associated with the specified screen name and widget context cache key.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes and returns the GenericWidgetOutput associated with the specified screen name and widget context cache key.
